metadata.question: Did nitrogen oxide concentrations in the Northern Hemisphere increase from 2019 to 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Compare 2019 vs 2020 for Northern Hemisphere - Date ranges: 2019-01-01 to 2019-12-31 and 2020-01-01 to 2020-12-31 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flag (qa_value) to filter good quality pixels - Filter by qa_value > 0.75 for reliable data - Use tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density band 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: A real decrease to near-zero (unlikely for global hemisphere average) - C1: If collections are empty - C2: If no valid pixels after masking - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - Compare 2019 vs 2020 averages: if 2020 > 2019 → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const northernHemisphere = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-180, 0], [180, 0], [180, 90], [-180, 90], [-180, 0]] ]); const date2019Start = '2019-01-01'; const date2019End = '2019-12-31'; const date2020Start = '2020-01-01'; const date2020End = '2020-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(date2019Start, date2019End) .filterBounds(northernHemisphere) .filter(ee.Filter.gt('qa_value', 0.75)); const col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(date2020Start, date2020End) .filterBounds(northernHemisphere) .filter(ee.Filter.gt('qa_value', 0.75)); const size2019 = await col2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = await col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("No data found for one or both years."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NO2 for each year const no2_2019 = col2019.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').mean(); const no2_2020 = col2020.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').mean(); // 4. Calculation with pixel count validation const stats2019 = await no2_2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: northernHemisphere, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2020 = await no2_2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: northernHemisphere, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2019 = stats2019['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; const count2019 = stats2019['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; const mean2020 = stats2020['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; const count2020 = stats2020['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; console.log(`2019: Mean NO2 = ${mean2019}, Pixels = ${count2019}`); console.log(`2020: Mean NO2 = ${mean2020}, Pixels = ${count2020}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean2019 === null || mean2019 === undefined || mean2020 === null || mean2020 === undefined || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(mean2020)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } const percentChange = ((mean2020 - mean2019) / mean2019) * 100; console.log(`Change: ${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%`); if (mean2020 > mean2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
